# Arco official style base

Source: @arco-design/web-react 2.66.18, https://registry.npmjs.org/@arco-design/web-react/-/web-react-2.66.18.tgz.

Concatenated unmodified CSS: global tokens, Button, Input, Select, Pagination, Table, Checkbox, Breadcrumb, Modal, Tabs. MIT license retained. This is the official CSS base applied to the existing React controls; it does not install or claim use of Arco React runtime components.
